The tools you need, where you expect them.

A proper view of your inbox

Use the folder tree, sortable message list and reading pane to find your way around. Choose stacked panes or a side-by-side layout, and switch between all mail and unread messages.

Write, reply and get things done

Compose plain-text messages with Cc, Bcc, attachments and a signature. Drafts save on your device. The undo-send countdown gives you a moment to catch that last detail.

Keep important messages close

Star a message, organise your mail with local tags, or snooze a conversation until later. Search cached messages by sender, subject, date or attachment. The local Address Book keeps useful contacts within reach.

Your existing account, connected directly

The web application uses JMAP. The desktop application also supports IMAP and SMTP with provider app passwords. Mail travels between your device and your provider, without a Mail Wizard backend to manage.

Privacy, connections & system requirements

Mail Wizard is an email client, not an email hosting service. It does not issue email addresses or remove your provider's fees and limits. This is the initial release and has not been independently security-audited.

Connected accounts: credentials, cached mail and local drafts are encrypted on this device with AES-256-GCM and a passphrase-derived key. A forgotten vault passphrase cannot be recovered. This is local storage encryption, not end-to-end email encryption. While unlocked, the application can access your messages. Export a backup before clearing browser data.

Web application: a current browser with HTTPS, IndexedDB and WebCrypto is required. JMAP needs a provider token and a server that permits browser connections. Fastmail documents direct browser support. Gmail and Outlook do not offer standard JMAP endpoints for this application. Install from your browser menu where available, or use Add to Home Screen.

Desktop application: Electron source and packaging are supplied for current Windows, macOS and Linux systems. IMAP requires TLS; SMTP requires TLS or STARTTLS. App-password support depends on the provider. Microsoft OAuth and one-click Gmail OAuth are not implemented. Windows 7 is not a supported operating system for this release. Unsigned desktop builds may display operating-system verification prompts.

Local features: search covers loaded mail; tags, snooze, drafts and contacts are stored locally. Keep the application open to sync mail or complete an undo-send countdown. There is no background delivery service. Plain-text reading blocks remote email images and scripts. The app includes no advertising scripts or product analytics; hosting infrastructure and mail providers may retain their own operational logs.
